messages:
Jules (People Ops): Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands Q&A on leveling, comp, and benefits. I'll answer the leftover items and tag folks for finance/benefits where needed. Drop anything else here. :wave:

Ken (Eng): Thx. Two questions: 1) If a promotion is approved right before payroll closes, does the raise land in that run? 2) Can retroactive pay be applied back to the review period?

Jules (People Ops): Short: if approval happens before payroll cutoff we include it; otherwise next payroll. Retro pay is possible but needs a manager request within 30 days of the People Ops approval timestamp and Finance sign-off. Longer backdating needs Exec approval.

Sam (Manager): Clarify the "approval timestamp" — is that when manager submits or when People Ops finalizes? Important for the 30-day rule.

Jules (People Ops): It's the People Ops finalization timestamp in the HR system. That's the canonical time for payroll and retro windows.

Olga (Finance): Adding: bonuses are determined by the declaration date. Promotions approved before the bonus declaration date are treated at the new level for that year's bonus. If after, we prorate by days-at-level. Manual payroll edits can take up to two cycles to appear.

Ken (Eng): Mid-search level bump: if a req moves up a band during interviews, should recruiters tell active candidates immediately? We've had candidates surprised otherwise.

Jules (People Ops): Yes — update the req band, notify active candidates, and tag the hiring manager + finance so offers can be reissued if unsigned. Signed offers aren't changed retroactively except in rare agreed cases.

Sam (Manager): Parental leave edge-case: employee on leave missed open enrollment. Any exceptions?

Jules (People Ops): Qualifying life events (birth/adoption) permit mid-year enrollment. If open enrollment was missed because the person was on leave, submit a case to people-ops@redwood.com with dates and we'll evaluate. Tag @HR-Notifier to create a ticket.

Ken (Eng): Equity refresh timing after promotion? I heard different guidance across teams.

Jules (People Ops): Guideline: typically eligible for refresh discussions ~6 months after promotion. Managers can request exceptions during comp windows; approvals require manager + People Ops + Finance.

Ava (CEO): Leadership ask: please produce a single-page FAQ that clarifies: timeline from submission to payroll effect, the retro window and how to request it, appeals steps and timing, and manager checklist for calibration prep. Keep it short and pin it to the channel.

Jules (People Ops): Will do. I'll post the one-pager and a 2-item manager checklist by Thursday and pin it.

HR-Notifier: Reminder: comp calibration packets due to #people-ops by 4/18 17:00 UTC. Upload via HR portal.

Ken (Eng): Thanks all 94 this helps a lot.

Jules (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you have a private case, DM me and include "private appeal" in the subject. I'll keep this thread pinned for the week. :pushpin:
